desc:
WATER POLICE PRISON RUN! (Obby)

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to support the game.

Complete 25 obstacle stages and make your way through the water prison to escape. Jump across platforms, avoid tricky traps, and complete simple parkour challenges with smooth, easy-to-learn controls as you run through flooded areas, dodge obstacles, and escape the water police!

Play solo or with friends as you race to freedom through exciting water-themed stages. Improve your best time and view your results on the leaderboard. Colorful obstacle gameplay designed to be family-friendly and fun for all ages.

Tags: Obby, Parkour, Platformer, Stages, Fun, Family Friendly, Prison, Escape, Run, Challenge, Water, Police
